## Erosion-CN v1.0.5 (Build 30)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**：`iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**：Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Fixed Unresponsive "Clean Selected" in Container Cache Cleaner (`CacheCleanerView`) / 修复容器缓存「一键清理已选」不生效** *(Thanks to [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) for reporting [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53) / 感谢 [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) 反馈 [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53))*
   - **Separated Button Styles in Overview Card**：Assigned `.borderless` to **Rescan** (`重新扫描`) and promoted **Clean Selected** (`一键清理已选`) to a full-width `.borderedProminent` button snapshotting targets prior to confirmation, eliminating SwiftUI `List` multi-button tap hijacking.
   - **Prevented Row Hit-Box Hijacking**：Replaced inline `NavigationLink` on **Inspect** (`查看`) with a `.borderless` button + `.navigationDestination(item:)` so tapping row checkboxes or **Clean** (`清理`) never triggers accidental navigation.
   - **Ad-Sentinel Protection & Re-Sized Refresh**：Unified scan/purge traversal depth (`Library/Caches` depth `7`, `tmp` depth `6`), skipped `.erosion_adlock` anti-recreate ad folders during cleanup, and updated remaining bytes / auth failure reporting accurately after purge.

2. **Explicit Read-Only & Sentinel State in `InfoViewer` / 文件详情页只读与防重建状态提示**
   - When a directory or file is already at `0555` / `0444`, the **Set Read-Only** preset button now automatically disables and displays `Already Read-Only` (`当前已是只读锁死状态`) or `Read-Only & Sentinel Active` (`当前已是只读防重建锁死状态`) alongside an `Anti-Recreate Lock` row (`Active (.erosion_adlock)`).
   - **Restore Read-Write** and **Apply** buttons disable when permissions already match, and restoring write permission on a sentinel directory from `InfoViewer` cleanly unlinks `.erosion_adlock`.

3. **Target Highlighting & Auto-Scroll on Ad Locator (`FileBrowserView` / `AdCacheBlockerView`) / 去广告「定位」自动高亮与居中定位**
   - Tapping **Locate** (`定位`) in Splash Ad Blocker now highlights the target ad folder/config inside its parent directory and scrolls smoothly to center it, with read-only sandbox grants for locator browsing and container grants ordered prior to `lstat` attribute checks.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

---
